plugin.comment: Point this at the Git URL (and optionally a #tag/commit) of THIS plugin. Paste this JSON into the OutSystems mobile module's 'Extensibility Configuration' property.

_notes: MABS 12 is required (Kotlin/Glance + modern Swift toolchain).

iOS: the WidgetKit extension target is injected by the plugin's after_prepare hook. Confirm with OutSystems Support that MABS 12 can build & sign a 2nd iOS target before relying on the iOS production build (design doc R1).
iOS signing additionally requires Apple Developer assets (App Group + extension App ID + regenerated provisioning profiles) — see design doc §3.
